text:
maria-cs: FYI — AcmeCorp flagged their EOM invoice is ~ $6.5k lower than the dashboard total. They say multiple line items show under the lower plan tier. Screenshot + invoice id linked: https://redwood.internal/attachments/INV-8812-snap.png :eyes:
josh-support: Thanks — can you paste the account id and the invoice id? Which cutoff window?
maria-cs: acct: acct_0047A, invoice: INV-8812, window: 2026-02-01 -> 2026-02-28 (UTC). Customer on Enterprise+ with usage spike on 02-27.
billing-bot: ledger-sync completed for 2026-02-28 00:05 UTC (job id: lg-sync-20260228-07)
tian-ops: Did any backfill or migration run around that window? I remember a credits migration last week.
devin-billing: Pulling activity now. Quick heads-up: I see a recent "phased_credits" migration executed 2026-02-28 00:02 that had a rollback marker set for older invoices. Query snippet:```sql
SELECT invoice_id, plan_tier, applied_credits, computed_tier
FROM invoice_lines
WHERE account_id = 'acct_0047A' AND period_start >= '2026-02-01';
```
result sample:
```
INV-8812 | Enterprise+ | 0.00 | Enterprise+
INV-8812 | Pro        | 6500.00 | Pro
```
maria-cs: Wait, so the same invoice has both Enterprise+ and Pro lines? The customer says dashboard shows everything as Enterprise+. :confused:
josh-support: That looks like the migration duplicated a credit line that pushed a subset of usage into a lower-tier bucket. Could be proration logic. Devin, can you repro locally with the same migration flags?
devin-billing: Repro steps I'm using: 1) checkout billing-migrations@feat/phased-credits 2) run `scripts/migrate_phased_credits --dry-run --cutoff 2026-02-28` 3) inspect `invoice_lines` diff. On dry-run it shows the credits being applied to older usage windows when the `--rollback-apply` flag is present.
tian-ops: If that's true, the invoice calc job (invoice-recalc) might have re-run and picked the wrong credits mapping. We should avoid touching production invoices until we confirm.
maria-cs: Customer is already on a call; Can we give ETA? They're asking why totals differ. :phone:
josh-support: Immediate plan: (1) disable cron for lg-sync backfill (2) run a targeted invoice-recalc for INV-8812 in read-only mode to produce a diff (3) if diff confirms, schedule a safe recompute and reissue invoice + credit note. Who owns step 2?
devin-billing: I'll run the read-only recompute now and post diff. If it matches dashboard, it's the migration. If it matches invoice, something else upstream changed. Posting diff in ~15m.
billing-bot: incident-tracker created: INC-2026-2875 (priority: high)
tian-ops: cc @oncall-sre for approval to pause backfill.
maria-cs: Please tell customer we're investigating, prioritized high, ETA ~2 hours pending diffs.
josh-support: Thanks team. Devin — ping when diff is up and we'll draft the customer-facing explanation + next steps. :thumbsup:
